_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE broadcast showcase config. EVERY VALUE BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER: it
describes no clip and must be replaced before it is run. It exists so the schema
is unambiguous and so a config can be written without trial and error.
Frame indices are zero-based frames of THIS CLIP. A whole shot is rendered end to
end at the source's own cadence with the source's own audio; overlays and metrics
are drawn ONLY inside the scene windows below, and at a cut everything is
cleared: body, trails, cards, phase badge and the hand_rise reference frame.
Scene blocks use the demo-config vocabulary, so docs/demo-mode.md documents them.
Keys beginning with _ are ignored by the loader.

shot.label: Illustrative: hole 7 approach (not a real shot)
shot.source_notes: illustrative only; the operator records the real clip here

scenes.label: Illustrative: golfer visible, address to finish

window.note: illustrative: first golfer-visible window, ends before the cut to the flight view

roi_keyframes.note: illustrative: crop follows the camera pan

scenes.label: Illustrative: second golfer window after the cut

window.note: illustrative: the reaction/flight frames 151..299 carry NO overlay at all

scenes.notes: illustrative scene; nothing is carried over from golfer_window_1

timing.source_cadence_caveat: illustrative: the source may be a replay or a slow-motion capture; container cadence places frames in the source timeline and is never treated as measured action time

overrides.note: illustrative: operator accepted this proposal and ended golfer_window_1 above

source_description: illustrative: the operator's own description of what the clip is, who is in it and what it is not. Recorded verbatim; the tool never identifies a person or a rights status.
notes: illustrative values only, not measurements of any clip.
